data.title: Urbana II
data.about:
Urbana II by Emaar is an exciting project offering 2 & 3 bedroom tiered townhouses. Offering a tranquil setting, these homes have the best lifestyle in the midst of nature. With an 18-hole Championship Golf Course just steps away from you, at Urbana II you can only expect the best.

As a resident at Urbana II, you will have access to green parks, shopping outlets leisure centres, swimming pools and more. Each townhouse is eclectically designed with beautiful spacious interiors and equally well-crafted exteriors. The best family-oriented community by Emaar, Urbana II is located within Emaar South, just minutes away from the iconic attractions of the city.

characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• This is phase 2 of Emaar’s South Urbana development. 
  • These are split level townhouses advertised by Emaar. 
  • Majority of units for Urbana Phase 1 were sold at prices ranging from AED 900,000 – 1,350,000. 95% of the project was sold out on launch day and a few remaining units were sold out on subsequent days.
